paras: Application: 2020+ Toyota GR Supra (MK5) – B58 3.0L turbo only Part Type: CCV Fluid Lock oil catch can kit Part Number: 20-0750-FL

The Radium CCV catch can kit runs inline between the crankcase vent (CCV) port and the intake pipe of the B58-powered GR Supra. Under high load (WOT) this circuit sees high crankcase flow, carrying oil into the intake pipe and intercooler where it reduces intercooler efficiency – the catch can captures it first.
